what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5467 Iranian refugees in France, 3.5% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1991 to 2025, and over Kurdistan territory in some years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 3535 refugees and fell to a low in 2006.
It then rose and is at its highest at the end of 2025; the main years of displacement in the data are 1995 to 1998 and 2018 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
